documents.title: Bambu Filament Technical Data Sheet V1.0: PVA
Bambu PVA Safety Data Sheet SDS20251127S04
Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS, build plate and glue compatibility

notes: No hex: the store page links no hex-code document for this filament and none is cached, so its only colour value "Clear (66400)" has no published hex.
No in-the-box list: no official packing list exists for this filament (the store page has no What's in the Box section).

not_published: the TDS states "N/A" for the glass transition, crystallization and Vicat softening temperatures, both heat deflection rows (1.8 and 0.45 MPa) and every mechanical row (Young's modulus, tensile strength, breaking elongation, bending modulus, bending strength, impact strength; X-Y and Z). Filament length and hardness are stated in none of the documents searched. The material-table wiki only groups PVA among filaments "with a softening temperature below 60 ℃" (no value, no method), which proves no Vicat value.
Density and melting temperature are raw-material properties from the TDS "Physical Properties" table; no printed-specimen (mechanical) value exists for this filament.

TDS facts with no registry key are not stored: melt index 7.2 ± 1.1 g/10 min (210 °C, 2.16 kg), saturated water absorption rate 6.25% (25 °C, 55% RH), crystallization temperature N/A, printing and storage humidity < 20% RH (sealed, with desiccant), retraction length 0.6 - 1.0 mm, retraction speed 20 - 40 mm/s, max overhang angle 55°, max bridging length ~ 30 mm, support material "/", odor, skin hazards, chemical stability, solubility (soluble in water), chemical resistance, flammability and combustion products. TDS facts that have a key but are not stored as spec rows: the Nozzle Size row "0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8 mm" (extrusion.supported_nozzle_diameters is not written: the row lists the 0.2 mm nozzle, which the store page (Cautions for Use "0.2 mm Nozzle NOT Compatible"), its FAQ, its Support Filament Comparison table and the material-table wiki all exclude for this filament, so a spec row would state a size the product page warns against; the row is kept as the conflict of the 0.2 mm nozzle relation, as the PLA, PETG and Support for PLA/PETG files keep their Nozzle Size row as a relation), chamber temperature 25 - 45 °C (thermal.chamber_temp is one number, a printer's chamber maximum, not a filament's recommended range), spool material PC+ABS (temperature resistance 90 °C) and spool size 200 × 67 mm (a material and a size, not a spool type; see material.spool_type), bed surface preparation glue (kept as the recommended_with relation "Glue") and the X1 Series heatbed drying 90 - 100 °C, 12 h (one row per drying key: the blast-oven condition is stored, the heatbed one is in its test_condition).

SDS facts not stored: product name "Bambu PVA"; the model designation "S04-xx" (p.2, section 1: "Model : S04-xx(xx stands for any suffix)"), a code pattern rather than this product's model, so identity.model is not written (the builder writes "PVA", which a curated official_doc row would outrank and replace; as in the other filament files); CLP "Not classified", conditions to avoid ("Avoid fire, elevated temperatures. direct sunlight.") and "Not hazardous goods" for sea, road and air transport. Its section 9 "No data available" for melting point and density does not override the TDS values.

Source disagreements kept for review: nozzle temperature (TDS 220 - 250 °C vs material-table wiki 190 - 240 °C ±10 °C, loading at 240 - 250 °C in the PVA guide); bed temperature on the non-Cool plates (TDS 35 - 45 °C vs material-table wiki 45 - 65 ℃); blast-oven drying (TDS and support wiki 80 °C, 8 - 12 h vs material-table wiki 55 ℃, 8 h); the 0.2 mm nozzle (TDS Nozzle Size lists it, the store page, store FAQ and material-table wiki exclude it); AMS lite (store "All AMS Series Compatible" vs support wiki "not recommended"); A series (material-table wiki "Compatible" vs support wiki "not recommended"). The product TDS values are kept for specs.

Marketing prose proves no number and is not stored: the overview and feature sections ("Soak and Dissolve", "Seamless Support Interface Surface", "Thorough and Clean Dissolution", "zero top interface spacing") and the Highlights ("ONLY used for support", "Not to be used for standalone models", "Dry Out Before Use").
material.diameter_tolerance (± 0.03 mm) is the store page's own row (Product Features › bullet 5); the TDS gives no tolerance, so it is not restated here and not marked not_published.

The store page links a "Filament RoHS" certificate (https://store.bblcdn.com/s7/default/5a9005351ca8426b8fa2b1b61c8ef4fc/RoHS_report_Bambu_PVA.pdf) that was not cached and not read, so safety.certifications is neither curated nor marked not_published. The store page also links the wiki "Reduce the risk of prints leakage guide" (https://wiki.bambulab.com/en/filament/reduce-vase-leaking-guide), not cached and not read (post-processing, no spec key).

The store has no Refill value for PVA (Type group: "Filament with spool" only), so no spool requirement is recorded. The store FAQ (7.Safety Tips) says the filament "is not food-grade"; the same list also says it "contains highly hygroscopic wood fibers", which contradicts the TDS and SDS composition (polyvinyl alcohol) and reads as a copied sentence. No registry key holds either, and neither is stored.

Adjudication against the second extraction (49 field disagreements): locator separators, the material.type wording ("Polyvinyl alcohol", the TDS p.3 Composition cell, not "PVA (polyvinyl alcohol)"), the length of the drying quotes, the AMS rows (one row per member of "All AMS Series" in compat-targets.json), the printer-row locator, the PETG source (the PVA Printing Guide; the support wiki states the same sentence) and the PLA split ("PLA" from the store bullet, "PLA-CF/GF" from the support wiki row) keep this file's form. material.spool_type stays the store bullet "High Temperature Reusable Spool" (unverified): the TDS rows "Spool Material PC+ABS (Temperature resistance 90 °C)" and "Spool Size Diameter: 200 mm; Height: 67 mm" give the spool's material and size, not its type. The Glue relation is recommended_with / part (TDS "Bed Surface Preparation Glue" under "Recommended Printing Settings"; the material-table wiki requires glue only on the Engineering Plate), changed from requires by the independent check. Not added from the second extraction: extrusion.supported_nozzle_diameters and thermal.chamber_temp (see the TDS note), identity.model (see the SDS note) and material.diameter_tolerance (the store page's own row already holds 0.03 mm; a curated row from the same page would change nothing). The nozzle and plate relations the second extraction lacked are stated by the TDS p.1 Bed Type row and the material-table wiki rows and are kept. material.net_weight is written as 0.5 kg, the TDS's own figure (the merge stores 500 g, equal to the store page row). Every one-sided or differing item was re-read in the cached TDS, SDS, wiki pages and store page.
